import { createHash } from "node:crypto";

export const sha256 = (value: string | Uint8Array): string => createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");

/** The controller diagram used in the user-visible three-change demo. */
const prefix = [
  '[D] Controller edits / agent access',
  '|',
  '|-- UI -> MappingDocumentController',
  '|   |-- commitDocument(...)    grid edits',
  '|   |-- updateCanvas(...)     pane/control state',
  '|   `-- undo(redo = false)    document + canvas history',
  '|',
  '`-- Agent -> MCP -> HTTP backend'
];
const suffix = ['', 'Source: mappingDocumentController.ts; sessionService.ts'];
export const controllerBefore = [...prefix,
  '    `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService',
  '        `-- CanvasSessionBridge -> browser poll/reply',
  '            `-- transact(expectedVersion, operations[])',
  '                |-- draw / replace / move / collapse / remove',
  '                |-- clone + validate + layout',
  '                `-- publish -> floating layout -> one undo',
  '',
  'exec: synchronous QuickJS canvas/nodes methods.',
  'diagram-search: search + full saved/live reads.',
  'canvas-api-search: documentation, not drawn objects.',
  'save_diagram: catalog revision -> explorer + search.',
  '',
  'UI shares history; not all edits use transact validation.',
  'Measurements do not add undo entries or bump version.',
  'Live edits require an open Mapping page.',
  ...suffix
].join('\n');
export const controllerPatch = [
  '    `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService',
  '        |-- no changeSessionId',
  '        |   `-- bridge -> live browser controller',
  '        `-- changeSessionId',
  '            `-- ChangeSessionService',
  '                `-- proposed document controller',
  '',
  'Session edits (preview copies)',
  '|-- nodes.patchDiagram(start, end, patch)',
  '|-- nodes.draw(...) + edges.create(...)',
  '`-- undo / redo / reset',
  '',
  'Original / Proposed switches the preview snapshot.',
  'Session edits persist without saving originals.',
  'Acceptance into originals is a future step.'
].join('\n');
export const expectedAddedLabels = ['no changeSessionId', 'bridge -> live browser controller', 'changeSessionId',
  'ChangeSessionService', 'proposed document controller', 'Session edits (preview copies)',
  'nodes.patchDiagram(start, end, patch)', 'nodes.draw(...) + edges.create(...)', 'undo / redo / reset'];
export const expectedUnchangedLabels = ['UI -> MappingDocumentController', 'commitDocument(...)    grid edits',
  'updateCanvas(...)     pane/control state', 'undo(redo = false)    document + canvas history'];

[P] DiagramDatasetCatalogSnapshot`
  }

export const MAPPING_POC_GRAPH_B = MAPPING_POC_B_SECTION_DEFINITIONS
  .map((section) => section.ascii)
  .join("\n\n");

export const MAPPING_POC_GRAPH_B_LINE_COUNT = MAPPING_POC_GRAPH_B.split("\n").length;

export function logicalLineCount(ascii: string): number {
  return ascii.split("\n").length;
}

export interface MappingPocNodeExtent {
  startLine: number;
  endLine: number;
}

export interface MappingPocNodeHead {
  line: number;
  startColumn: number;
  endColumn: number;
}

export interface MappingPocSourceRange {
  path: string;
  startLine: number;
  endLine: number;
}

export interface MappingPocBNode {
  id: string;
  entityId: string;
  label: string;
  head: MappingPocNodeHead;
  sourceRanges: readonly MappingPocSourceRange[];
}

export interface MappingPocBSection {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  startLine: number;
  endLine: number;
}

export interface MappingPocANode {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  head: MappingPocNodeHead;
  extent: MappingPocNodeExtent;
  selectableBecause: "mapped" | "important-code-entity";
  sourceRanges: readonly MappingPocSourceRange[];
  mappedBNodeIds: readonly string[];
}

export interface MappingPocProjection {
  selectedANodeIds: string[];
  mappedANodeIds: string[];
  directlyMappedBNodeIds: string[];
  selectedBNodeIds: string[];
  mappedBRange: MappingPocNodeExtent | null;
  alignedBRange: MappingPocNodeExtent | null;
  alignedSectionIds: string[];
  /** Backward-compatible display range; identical to alignedBRange. */
  bRange: MappingPocNodeExtent | null;
  bBounds: MappingPocGridRect | null;
  bAscii: string;
}

export interface MappingPocGridRect {
  startLine: number;
  endLine: number;
  startColumn: number;
  endColumn: number;
}

function headAt(ascii: string, line: number, token: string): MappingPocNodeHead {
  const text = ascii.split("\n")[line - 1];
  const offset = text?.indexOf(token) ?? -1;
  if (offset < 0) throw new Error(`Mapping POC token not found at line ${line}: ${token}`);
  return { line, startColumn: offset + 1, endColumn: offset + token.length };
}

function headContaining(ascii: string, token: string): MappingPocNodeHead {
  const exactLine = token.endsWith("\n");
  const needle = exactLine ? token.slice(0, -1) : token;
  const matches = ascii.split("\n").flatMap((line, index) => {
    const offset = exactLine && line.trim() !== needle ? -1 : line.indexOf(needle);
    return offset < 0 ? [] : [{ line: index + 1, startColumn: offset + 1, endColumn: offset + needle.length }];
  });
  if (matches.length !== 1) throw new Error(`Mapping POC token must occur once: ${needle}`);
  return matches[0];
}

function sourceRange(path: string, startLine: number, endLine: number): MappingPocSourceRange {
  return { path, startLine, endLine };
}

function bNode(
  id: string,
  entityId: string,
  label: string,
  token: string,
  sourceRanges: readonly MappingPocSourceRange[]
): MappingPocBNode {
  return {
    id,
    entityId,
    label,
    head: headContaining(MAPPING_POC_GRAPH_B, token),
    sourceRanges
  };
}

function bNodes(
  path: string,
  startLine: number,
  endLine: number,
  specs: ReadonlyArray<readonly [id: string, token: string, label?: string]>
): MappingPocBNode[] {
  return specs.map(([id, token, label]) => bNode(
    `b-${id}`,
    `poc-${id}`,
    label ?? token.replace(/^\[[PRX]\]\s*/, "").replace(/\(\)$/, ""),
    token,
    [sourceRange(path, startLine, endLine)]
  ));
}

let sectionStartLine = 1;
export const MAPPING_POC_B_SECTIONS: readonly MappingPocBSection[] = MAPPING_POC_B_SECTION_DEFINITIONS.map(
  (section, index) => {
    const lineCount = logicalLineCount(section.ascii);
    const result = {
      id: section.id,
      label: section.label,
      startLine: sectionStartLine,
      endLine: sectionStartLine + lineCount - 1
    };
    sectionStartLine += lineCount + (index < MAPPING_POC_B_SECTION_DEFINITIONS.length - 1 ? 1 : 0);
    return result;
  }
);

function normalizedPath(path: string): string {
  return path.replaceAll("\\", "/").replace(/^\.\//, "");
}

export function sourceRangesOverlap(
  left: MappingPocSourceRange,
  right: MappingPocSourceRange
): boolean {
  return normalizedPath(left.path) === normalizedPath(right.path)
    && left.startLine <= right.endLine
    && right.startLine <= left.endLine;
}

function bNodesForSourceRanges(sourceRanges: readonly MappingPocSourceRange[]): MappingPocBNode[] {
  return MAPPING_POC_B_NODES.filter((node) => node.sourceRanges.some(
    (bRange) => sourceRanges.some((aRange) => sourceRangesOverlap(aRange, bRange))
  ));
}

function aNode(
  id: string,
  label: string,
  line: number,
  token: string,
  startLine = line,
  endLine = line,
  sourceRanges: readonly MappingPocSourceRange[] = []
): MappingPocANode {
  const mappedBNodeIds = bNodesForSourceRanges(sourceRanges).map((node) => node.id);
  return {
    id,
    label,
    head: headAt(MAPPING_POC_GRAPH_A, line, token),
    extent: { startLine, endLine },
    selectableBecause: mappedBNodeIds.length ? "mapped" : "important-code-entity",
    sourceRanges,
    mappedBNodeIds
  };
}

const A_NODES_BY_ID = new Map(MAPPING_POC_A_NODES.map((node) => [node.id, node]));

export function selectANodesInRect(rect: MappingPocGridRect): MappingPocANode[] {
  const startLine = Math.min(rect.startLine, rect.endLine);
  const endLine = Math.max(rect.startLine, rect.endLine);
  const startColumn = Math.min(rect.startColumn, rect.endColumn);
  const endColumn = Math.max(rect.startColumn, rect.endColumn);
  return MAPPING_POC_A_NODES.filter((node) => (
    node.head.line >= startLine
    && node.head.line <= endLine
    && node.head.startColumn <= endColumn
    && node.head.endColumn >= startColumn
  ));
}

export function alignBRangeToSections(mappedRange: MappingPocNodeExtent | null): {
  range: MappingPocNodeExtent | null;
  sectionIds: string[];
} {
  if (!mappedRange) return { range: null, sectionIds: [] };
  const sections = MAPPING_POC_B_SECTIONS.filter((section) => (
    section.startLine <= mappedRange.endLine && mappedRange.startLine <= section.endLine
  ));
  if (!sections.length) return { range: mappedRange, sectionIds: [] };
  return {
    range: {
      startLine: Math.min(mappedRange.startLine, sections[0].startLine),
      endLine: Math.max(mappedRange.endLine, sections[sections.length - 1].endLine)
    },
    sectionIds: sections.map((section) => section.id)
  };
}

export function projectASelectionToB(
  selectedANodeIds: readonly string[],
  diagramNodes?: readonly MappingPocANode[]
): MappingPocProjection {
  const nodesById = diagramNodes ? new Map(diagramNodes.map((node) => [node.id, node])) : A_NODES_BY_ID;
  const selectedA = [...new Set(selectedANodeIds)].map((id) => {
    const node = nodesById.get(id);
    if (!node) throw new Error(`Unknown Graph A node: ${id}`);
    return node;
  }).sort((left, right) => left.head.line - right.head.line || left.head.startColumn - right.head.startColumn);
  const directlyMappedB = MAPPING_POC_B_NODES.filter((node) => selectedA.some((aNode) => (
    aNode.sourceRanges.some((aRange) => node.sourceRanges.some((bRange) => sourceRangesOverlap(aRange, bRange)))
  )));
  const startLine = directlyMappedB.length
    ? Math.min(...directlyMappedB.map((node) => node.head.line))
    : null;
  const endLine = directlyMappedB.length
    ? Math.max(...directlyMappedB.map((node) => node.head.line))
    : null;
  const mappedBRange = startLine === null || endLine === null ? null : { startLine, endLine };
  const aligned = alignBRangeToSections(mappedBRange);
  const alignedBRange = aligned.range;
  const selectedB = alignedBRange
    ? MAPPING_POC_B_NODES.filter((node) => node.head.line >= alignedBRange.startLine && node.head.line <= alignedBRange.endLine)
    : [];
  const graphBLines = MAPPING_POC_GRAPH_B.split("\n");
  const rawSlice = alignedBRange ? graphBLines.slice(alignedBRange.startLine - 1, alignedBRange.endLine) : [];
  const nonEmptyColumns = rawSlice.flatMap((line) => {
    const first = line.search(/\S/);
    return first < 0 ? [] : [{ start: first + 1, end: line.trimEnd().length }];
  });
  const startColumn = nonEmptyColumns.length ? Math.min(...nonEmptyColumns.map((item) => item.start)) : null;
  const endColumn = nonEmptyColumns.length ? Math.max(...nonEmptyColumns.map((item) => item.end)) : null;
  const bBounds = alignedBRange && startColumn !== null && endColumn !== null
    ? { ...alignedBRange, startColumn, endColumn }
    : null;
  return {
    selectedANodeIds: selectedA.map((node) => node.id),
    mappedANodeIds: selectedA.filter((node) => node.mappedBNodeIds.length).map((node) => node.id),
    directlyMappedBNodeIds: directlyMappedB.map((node) => node.id),
    selectedBNodeIds: selectedB.map((node) => node.id),
    mappedBRange,
    alignedBRange,
    alignedSectionIds: aligned.sectionIds,
    bRange: alignedBRange,
    bBounds,
    bAscii: bBounds
      ? rawSlice.map((line) => line.slice(bBounds.startColumn - 1, bBounds.endColumn)).join("\n")
      : ""
  };
}

export const MAPPING_POC_PROGRESSIVE_SELECTIONS = [
  { aNodeIds: ["a-system-templates"], expectedSectionIds: ["inputs"] },
  { aNodeIds: ["a-system-templates", "a-diagram-set"], expectedSectionIds: ["inputs"] },
  { aNodeIds: ["a-system-templates", "a-diagram-set", "a-create-config"], expectedSectionIds: ["inputs", "initialize", "prompt-selection", "generation-plan", "prompt-config"] },
  { aNodeIds: ["a-system-templates", "a-diagram-set", "a-create-config", "a-generate-artifact"], expectedSectionIds: ["inputs", "initialize", "prompt-selection", "generation-plan", "prompt-config", "model-generation"] }
] as const;

import { MAPPING_POC_GRAPH_A, type MappingPocNodeHead } from "./mappingPoc";

export interface MappingPocASection {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  startLine: number;
  endLine: number;
  anchorToken: string;
}

export interface MappingPocDetailOverlay {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  sectionId: string;
  anchorToken: string;
  ascii: string;
}

export interface MappingPocOverlayPlacement {
  overlayId: string;
  sectionId: string;
  originLine: number;
  originColumn: number;
  aAnchor: MappingPocNodeHead;
  overlayAnchor: MappingPocNodeHead;
}

export const MAPPING_POC_A_SECTIONS: readonly MappingPocASection[] = [
  { id: "profiles", label: "Persisted prompt profiles", startLine: 1, endLine: 30, anchorToken: "persistedPromptProfiles" },
  { id: "collection", label: "Diagram set and evidence collection", startLine: 31, endLine: 67, anchorToken: "evidenceCollection" },
  { id: "configuration", label: "Request and prompt configuration", startLine: 68, endLine: 120, anchorToken: "runtimeGenerationRequest" },
  { id: "agent-turns", label: "Agent session and prompt turns", startLine: 121, endLine: 153, anchorToken: "PiDiagramAgentRuntime.generateArtifact()" },
  { id: "outputs", label: "Validation and persisted outputs", startLine: 154, endLine: 183, anchorToken: "submissionValidation" }
];

export const MAPPING_POC_DETAIL_OVERLAYS: readonly MappingPocDetailOverlay[] = [
  {
    id: "profiles",
    label: "Prompt profile detail",
    sectionId: "profiles",
    anchorToken: "persistedPromptProfiles",
    ascii: `persistedPromptProfiles
      |
      +--> system-prompt-templates.json
      |       |
      |       +--> artifact-generation
      |       |      domain instruction
      |       |      one artifact
      |       |      7-bit ASCII
      |       |      submit_diagram contract
      |       |
      |       +--> diagram-reference
      |       |      complete replacement
      |       |      preserve source meaning
      |       |      apply reference grammar
      |       |
      |       \`--> diagram-mapping
      |              artifact unchanged
      |              exact entity spans
      |              no overlap
      |
      \`--> code-entity-prompt-templates.json
              |
              +--> identificationCriteria
              |      relevant evidence
              |      exact source ranges
              |
              \`--> compactionCriteria
                     retained/collapsed views
                     evidence-node mappings`
  },
  {
    id: "collection",
    label: "Evidence collection detail",
    sectionId: "collection",
    anchorToken: "evidenceCollection",
    ascii: `evidenceCollection
      |
      +--> DiagramSet
      |      name
      |      initialPrompt
      |      sourceCheckoutRoot
      |      codeEntitiesSetId
      |      readiness
      |
      +--> createCodeEntityPromptConfig()
      |      profile + revision
      |      identification criteria
      |      compaction criteria
      |      rendered context
      |
      +--> codeEntityCollectionPrompt()
      |      original request
      |      expected entity fields
      |      submit/retry instruction
      |
      \`--> PiDiagramAgentRuntime.collectEntities()
             |
             +--> corpus inspection tools
             +--> fixed collection system prompt
             +--> rendered context user prompt
             +--> submit_code_entities
             |
             \`--> validated CodeEntitiesSetRecord
                    exact files and ranges
                    status="finalized"`
  },
  {
    id: "configuration",
    label: "Generation configuration detail",
    sectionId: "configuration",
    anchorToken: "runtimeGenerationRequest",
    ascii: `runtimeGenerationRequest
      |
      +--> instruction + selectedCodeEntityIds[]
      +--> count + outputKind + viewKind + modelId
      +--> promptProfileId
      +--> references + referenceInstruction
      \`--> derivationCorrection
      |
      v
generateArtifacts()
      |
      v
generation HTTP route
      parse / validate / stream NDJSON
      |
      v
StudioApplication.generate()
      |
      +--> finalized evidence gate
      +--> load entities and references
      +--> createGenerationPromptConfig()
      |       resolve templates
      |       resolve mentions
      |       create readable aliases
      |       render system/context/reference/mapping prompts
      |
      +--> persist immutable GenerationPromptConfigRecord
      |
      \`--> beginBatch()
             create AgentRun per slot
             invoke candidates concurrently`
  },
  {
    id: "agent-turns",
    label: "Agent prompt-turn detail",
    sectionId: "agent-turns",
    anchorToken: "PiDiagramAgentRuntime.generateArtifact()",
    ascii: `PiDiagramAgentRuntime.generateArtifact()
      |
      +--> resolve selected model
      +--> load rendered systemPrompt
      +--> expose submit_diagram only
      \`--> create isolated in-memory session
      |
      v
turn 1: generate
      contextPrompt
      slot + candidate total
      readable aliases
      entity/artifact allowlists
      |
      v
turn 2: apply reference               [optional]
      previous candidate
      reference instruction/context
      complete replacement required
      |
      v
turn 3: map final artifact             [mandatory]
      numbered final ASCII
      allowed CodeEntities
      exact evidence ranges
      artifact must remain unchanged
      |
      v
submit_diagram
      name + ASCII + entity IDs + mappings`
  },
  {
    id: "outputs",
    label: "Validation and output detail",
    sectionId: "outputs",
    anchorToken: "submissionValidation",
    ascii: `submissionValidation
      |
      +--> resolve aliases to persisted entity IDs
      +--> require nonblank name
      +--> require 7-bit ASCII
      +--> reject entities outside allowlist
      +--> require final mappings
      +--> verify sourceRangeIndex
      +--> verify visible in-bounds spans
      +--> reject overlapping mappings
      \`--> mapping turn cannot change artifact
      |
      v
persistedOutputs
      |
      +--> DiagramRecord | DiagramComponentRecord
      |      normalized ASCII
      |      promptConfigId
      |      agentRunId
      |      derivation lineage
      |
      +--> DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
      |      artifact hash
      |      entity + source range
      |      exact visible span
      |
      \`--> completeBatch()
             deduplicate candidates
             persist artifacts + maps + runs
             update DiagramSet IDs
             return workspace`
  }
];

function uniqueTokenHead(ascii: string, token: string, context: string): MappingPocNodeHead {
  const matches = ascii.split("\n").flatMap((line, index) => {
    const offset = line.indexOf(token);
    return offset < 0 ? [] : [{
      line: index + 1,
      startColumn: offset + 1,
      endColumn: offset + token.length
    }];
  });
  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`${context} anchor must occur exactly once: ${token}`);
  }
  return matches[0];
}

export function parseOverlayPlacement(
  overlay: MappingPocDetailOverlay,
  graphA = MAPPING_POC_GRAPH_A
): MappingPocOverlayPlacement {
  const section = MAPPING_POC_A_SECTIONS.find((candidate) => candidate.id === overlay.sectionId);
  if (!section) throw new Error(`Unknown A section for overlay ${overlay.id}: ${overlay.sectionId}`);
  if (section.anchorToken !== overlay.anchorToken) {
    throw new Error(`Overlay ${overlay.id} anchor differs from section ${section.id}`);
  }
  const aAnchor = uniqueTokenHead(graphA, overlay.anchorToken, `Graph A/${section.id}`);
  const overlayAnchor = uniqueTokenHead(overlay.ascii, overlay.anchorToken, `Overlay/${overlay.id}`);
  if (aAnchor.line < section.startLine || aAnchor.line > section.endLine) {
    throw new Error(`Graph A anchor for ${overlay.id} falls outside section ${section.id}`);
  }
  return {
    overlayId: overlay.id,
    sectionId: section.id,
    originLine: aAnchor.line - overlayAnchor.line + 1,
    originColumn: aAnchor.startColumn - overlayAnchor.startColumn + 1,
    aAnchor,
    overlayAnchor
  };
}

export const MAPPING_POC_OVERLAY_PLACEMENTS: readonly MappingPocOverlayPlacement[] =
  MAPPING_POC_DETAIL_OVERLAYS.map((overlay) => parseOverlayPlacement(overlay));
